steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Water supply and drawer
steps.body: Are house water supply, fill hoses, and dispenser drawer clear of clogs?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Are house water supply, fill hoses, and dispenser drawer clear of clogs?

branches.label: Clog or supply issue
branches.oemOutcome: Clear clogged drawer/chambers and verify water supply.

steps.title: Inlet valves operate (TEST #6)
steps.body: Did TEST #6 confirm Cold 1, Cold 2, and Hot valves operate for detergent/bleach/softener paths?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Did TEST #6 confirm Cold 1, Cold 2, and Hot valves operate for detergent/bleach/softener paths?

branches.label: Valves OK
branches.oemOutcome: Replace dispensing system — valves functional but dispense fails.

branches.label: Valve fault
branches.oemOutcome: Complete TEST #6 Water Inlet Valves first.

steps.title: Service dispenser
steps.oemOutcome: Clean drawer and verify water paths.
